findings.evidence: Line 58 defines `lemma mem_basepointChangeSubgroup`; unlike the quotient representative lemmas at lines 76 and 94, it has no `@[simp]` annotation.

summary: The public basepoint-change subgroup surface is incomplete for the stated downstream use: users are told to unfold the definition for core inclusion and normality facts instead of being given characteristic lemmas.
